title: Add atomic release checkpoint, quiet staging guard, and minimal toolchain images
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: Release pipelines have intermittent flakiness during canary/smoke windows, and engineering teams need a low-friction, reproducible pre-merge snapshot to validate release artifacts before cutting stable releases. This PR introduces an 'atomic release checkpoint' workflow plus a quiet staging guard to reduce noisy premerge churn and a minimal toolchain image to speed preflight checks. What changed: Added .github/workflows/release-checkpoint.yml which creates a deterministic build snapshot, uploads a compact artifact, and runs a thin smoke suite; introduced build/toolchain/Dockerfile.min (alpine-based, trimmed toolchain) for preflight use; added tools/ci/keeper.go, a small Go helper that exposes artifact signing hooks and exponential backoff for flaky infra; added scripts/release-smoke.sh and README.ci.md documenting usage and rollout steps; minor updates to go.mod and Makefile to wire the minimal image into the preflight flow. Motivation: Reduce time-to-feedback for release engineers, make canary smoke deterministic and retry-safe, reduce CI image pull times, and provide a single checkpoint artifact teams can pin during rollback. Testing: Local smoke runs (scripts/release-smoke.sh) and full workflow runs on forked branch; CI flaky steps observed early were addressed by adding an idempotent artifact retrier and bumping timeouts for integration network calls. The GitHub Actions run passed on the final run: unit/lint/build -> pass, smoke -> pass, publish-checkpoint -> pass. Rollout: Gradual opt-in by release-manager teams via a feature flag in README.ci.md; the workflow is opt-in (comment trigger) until two release cycles have run. Checklist: [x] add workflow and docs [x] minimal toolchain image [x] retrier helper [x] smoke script and tests [x] reviewer feedback addressed [x] CI green. Commits and files changed are summarized below. Merge: squash and merge to main. Related: Linear ENG-2142 and ENG-2301 for release hardening and dependency hygiene. Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the minimal image minimal and does not change production runtime images. The keeper helper is feature-gated and defaults to no-op unless a GITHUB_TOKEN and SIGN_KEY are provided.

release_notes: Introduce an opt-in atomic release checkpoint workflow to produce deterministic preflight artifacts, add a minimal toolchain image to speed preflight checks, and include a retrier helper to reduce transient CI failures. Opt-in via comment trigger. No runtime or breaking changes.
